latest.title: Game names in the language you play in
latest.summary: A new Game names setting in the footer, beside Theme, shows the game's own names in any language the game ships: items, business types, neighbourhoods, stations, skills and staff demands, on the board, inside its findings and in the wiki, so the board reads like your game. The rest of the page stays English. Search finds a name in either language, and lists sort in the language you picked. If your browser prefers one of the game's languages, the board asks once whether to use it.
